name: Investtan Inc.
description:
The founding corporation of The Republic and seat of its executive authority.
Operates across industry, manufacturing, and active fleet combat — open to capsuleers of all skill levels and backgrounds.

name: Jay's Army
description:
A large francophone corporation built around mining and industrial production.
Active across highsec, lowsec, and wormhole space — all skill levels welcome, francophone pilots only.

name: Galactic Utility Services
description:
The alliance's dedicated logistics arm, specialising in highsec freight at competitive rates.
Keeps the supply lines of The Republic moving.

name: The Kansene Company
description:
The official family office of the Kansene and Ghekon families.
Conducts strategic investments across assets, structures, and emerging corporations on behalf of its principals.

name: Sovreign Materials Exchange
description:
A trading house operating within the alliance's economic sphere.
Provides wholesale material exchange services to member corporations and external partners.

name: Predictive Market Collective
description:
A low-tax corporation whose primary mandate is mentorship.
Members serve as instructors for newer pilots within the alliance — open to capsuleers with at least six months of experience.

name: Republic Capsuleer Academy
description:
The Republic's dedicated academy for new capsuleers.
Provides structured training and guidance to pilots taking their first steps in New Eden.

name: Covert Technologies LLC
description:
Handles operations that are not discussed in open channels.
Mandate and activities are known only to alliance command.
